scenario_rationales.repeated_weak: 4 supporting events across 2 sessions clears MIN_EVIDENCE_EVENTS=3 / MIN_EVIDENCE_SESSIONS=2, so promote_if_eligible must lift it out of provisional
scenario_rationales.under_evidenced: 2 events in 1 session is below both thresholds; a provisional fact must never be returned by top_fact_for_skill (it is not served to any payload)
scenario_rationales.repeated_strength: same evidence bar as repeated_weak, opposite polarity
scenario_rationales.mastery_conflict_weak: AUD-L-13: a weak_skill claim about a skill measured at 0.92 (>= WEAK_SKILL_THRESHOLD 0.7) contradicts the measurement and must be refused, however many events support it
scenario_rationales.mastery_conflict_strength: the direction AUD-L-13 was actually filed for: a strength fact for a skill measured at 0.25 is the `aud-student-regressing` reproduction
scenario_rationales.polarity_flip: after a sustained regression in the final window, what the tutor is served for this skill should reflect the regression, not the earlier strength
